item.title: Blockchain Association Rebuts Sheriffs' Claims on CLARITY Act in Senate Letter
item.summary: The Blockchain Association sent an eight-page letter to Senate leaders Thune and Schumer on August 3, 2026, rebutting the National Sheriffs' Association's claims that the CLARITY Act (H.R. 3633) would hinder crypto-crime enforcement, arguing the bill preserves criminal authorities while protecting noncontrolling software developers.
